messages:
Alex: quick handoff — I need to step out at 20:00 PT. handing oncall to @Maria. leaving a tiny preflight checklist, pls ack when you’ve validated everything.

Alex: checklist:
- VPN creds & route to prod-bastion ✅ (confirm)
- Pager provisioning for this rotation (email -> pager)
- Runbook links + most-recent postmortem pinned
- Service account keys rotated? location: s3://redwood-secrets/oncall-sa (decrypt with KMS)
- Short smoke for metrics/dashboard: open infra/cpu, infra/latency, queue/backlog
- Alerts muted to standard 5-min policy except P0s

Maria: acked, I’ll walk through these now. starting with VPN — testing below.
Maria: running: `ssh -J bastion@bastion.redwood.internal svc-admin@10.2.4.5` -> connected, can access /var/logs/runner. VPN+ssh look good.

Maria: pager check: running `pagerctl whoami` and `pagerctl rotations list --team infra`
Maria: output snip: `rotation: infra-oncall -> members: Maria, Sam` 
Maria: looks like I’m already in the rotation, but I don’t have escalation contact set. Jordan, can you confirm our escalation is set to +1 mobile?

Jordan: I’ll update escalation. FYI we had a mobile number change last week — I’ll push it in PagerDuty now.
Jordan: also reminder: if you hit the KMS decryption error, run `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sa_key.enc --profile oncall` (had to do this yesterday for Sam).

Sam: quick note — secrets rotation job is scheduled at 22:30 PT today. if you need old keys for a rollback, don’t delete the `oncall-sa-old` folder until 23:30.

Maria: got it. I’ll avoid deleting anything until after the rotation window.

Alex: runbooks — main link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/20345/Oncall+Runbook
Alex: please check the incident play for `gpu-pool-failure` (we saw a flakey node last week). the remediation steps are in the runbook under "Resource Recovery".

Maria: opened the runbook, skimmed the GPU recovery steps. one question: the restart command includes `systemctl restart rserve` — do we also need to clear the local cache?

Sam: yes, run `rm -rf /var/lib/rserve/cache/*` after service stop, then start. added to runbook comment.

Maria: thanks. I’ll add a short note in the runbook about the cache step and update the page with the command snippet.

deploy-bot: rotation update: oncall -> Maria (start: 1976543210, end: 1976629610). notifications sent to maria@redwood.ai and mobile.

Alex: perfect. last: if anything tricky comes up, escalate to Sam first if it’s infra, otherwise page Jordan for security/keys. I’ll be available on phone if needed.

Maria: ack — I’ve done the VPN, pager, runbook check, and noted the secrets rotation window. I’m taking ownership now. ping me in thread for quick questions. :thumbsup:

Sam: thanks — will monitor the secrets job and watch alerts for the next 2hrs.

Jordan: updated escalation contact and verified mobile ping test successful.

Alex: thanks everyone, handing off.

Maria: thanks — oncall confirmed.
